title: Explore digital agriculture with FAO
body: FAO’s e-Agriculture community shares discussion and resources about digital innovation in agriculture and rural development. Explore its resources and webinars to learn about the field beyond blockchain.

title: AI advisory in practice: Digital Green
body: Digital Green describes FarmerChat as an AI assistant for farmers, with attention to local language and conditions. Explore its work as a starting point for asking how digital advisory tools are designed and evaluated.

title: Your first agriculture data investigation
body: Choose a country and explore an agriculture indicator such as cereal yield or agricultural land in the World Bank’s Agriculture & Rural Development collection. Compare years, check units, and record missing values before drawing a conclusion.

title: Exedy Drones enters race to build American-made spray drones amid supply crunch
body: Reporting on a proposed product launch; delivery targets are company statements, not completed deployment.

title: Amatera tackles plant breeding bottleneck with high-throughput cell screening platform
body: Interview with the company. Publisher discloses its parent company is an investor. Performance claims need independent validation.

title: From innovations to impact: CGIAR Scaling Fund selects eight promising innovations
body: Research organisation announcement; funding selection is not proof of impact at scale.

title: Adaptive agriculture information factories: climate and market decision support
body: Project blog on combining Earth observation, climate and advisory data, including a Kenya maize use case.

title: How Indian Farmers Use Weather Forecasts to Plan Weeks Ahead
body: Examples of crop-specific advisory services that combine forecasts with field conditions; not a forecast for your farm.

title: El Niño looms large on World Food Day
body: Dated global climate context. Impacts vary by region and season; consult the latest local official forecast.

title: Extreme heat pushes agrifood systems to the brink
body: FAO–WMO report announcement covering heat risks to agriculture and adaptation. Page updated 24 April; original publication is 22 April.

title: Nigeria: GIEWS country brief
body: Reference date 16 September 2026 at review. The source URL is a rolling country page and may later show a newer edition.
